Western Auto Spares is an authorised Maruti Suzuki Genuine Parts Retail Outlet, dedicated to providing customers with 100% original and reliable spare parts for all Maruti Suzuki vehicles. As an authorised partner, we ensure that every product meets Maruti Suzuki’s strict quality standards, helping your car maintain peak performance, safety, and durability.

Our outlet offers a wide range of genuine spares and accessories – from engine and transmission parts to body panels, filters, brakes, and electrical components. Backed by trust and authenticity, Western Auto Spares is committed to giving vehicle owners, workshops, and service professionals easy access to genuine parts with assurance of warranty and long-term value.
